evidence.hubspot-crm: https://knowledge.hubspot.com/records/deduplication-of-records "if you try to manually create a contact with the same email address as an existing contact, HubSpot will alert you that a contact already exists"; the same for a company with the same domain. All products and plans. The duplicates manager for fuzzy matches (https://knowledge.hubspot.com/records/manage-duplicate-records) needs a Professional hub.
evidence.kiss: src/services/openklant2/service.ts:622 "ensureOk2Klant" silently reuses the OpenKlant partij found by BSN or KvK identifier (findKlantByIdentifierOpenKlant2) or creates one; there is no manual client create screen and so no duplicate warning

evidence.pipedrive: https://support.pipedrive.com/en/article/merge-duplicates the Merge Duplicates list shows "potential duplicate people and organizations" and the detail view of "any person or organization contact flagged as a potential duplicate item"; imports offer "the option to recognize and merge duplicates" (https://support.pipedrive.com/en/article/how-to-avoid-duplicates-during-an-import).
